spec.name: Modern Fluted Mushroom Table Lamp

parts.shape: Fluted cylinder with conical tapered top

details: Oversized curved dome shade measuring approximately 30 cm in diameter
Vertical fluted / reeded texture wrapping the cylindrical base body
Smooth tapered conical transition connecting the fluted base to the shade underside
Monochromatic all-white contemporary design standing roughly 40 cm high
spec.studio_prompt: A modern minimalist mushroom table lamp measuring 40 cm in height and 30 cm in diameter. The upper shade is a smooth, wide mushroom dome finished in glossy pure white (#f7f6fb). It is supported by a solid cylindrical base featuring distinct vertical fluted ridges along the main body and a smooth, untextured conical taper at the upper neck, rendered in a satin soft white finish (#f1f0f6). Clean monochromatic construction with subtle ambient light reflections.
